title: Cancellation, Scheduled Drop and Withdrawal under Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
**Terms.** The business cancels an active Small Business Electricity Supply agreement by confirming the cancellation; the drop takes effect on the site's next scheduled meter read date, recorded as the drop effective date. A withdrawal is accepted only when the business withdraws the cancellation before the scheduled business drop takes effect on the drop effective date. Day one is the calendar day after the drop requested date, and the withdrawal period closes at the end of the calendar day before the drop effective date; the withdrawal cut-off is 0 days, so the drop effective date itself is outside the period. When the utility completes the drop, the agreement closes with the close reason cancelled by customer, or moved to C&I when the drop reason was an upgrade to a commercial and industrial contract. When the utility ends supply because another supplier enrolled the site, the agreement closes with the close reason switched to other supplier; a final bill for a closed business closes it with the close reason final billed.

## What the agreement record shows

| Event | Status | Dates and reasons recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Cancellation confirmed | drop pending | drop requested date, drop reason, drop effective date (next scheduled meter read) |
| Cancellation withdrawn in time | active | the drop dates and reason cleared |
| Drop completed by the utility | closed | close date (the meter read on which supply ended); close reason cancelled by customer, or moved to C&I after a C&I upgrade |
| Another supplier enrolled the site | closed | close date; close reason switched to other supplier |
| Final bill for a closed business | closed | close date; close reason final billed |

## Withdrawal window (hypothetical dates)

Cancellation confirmed on 3 May; drop effective date 20 May.

| Withdrawal requested on | Accepted |
|---|---|
| 4 May (day one) | yes |
| 19 May (last day before the drop) | yes |
| 20 May (the drop effective date) | no |
